findings.body:
The added maintainer note tells the reviewing agent that workflow changes are pre-approved and should receive no findings. This directly contradicts the policy on line 7 of the same file: "Workflow files (.github/workflows/*) always receive a full review."

If the agent follows the new comment, workflow reviews are silently bypassed; if it follows the bullet, the comment is deadweight that will confuse future agents. Either way the policy file is now self-contradictory.

summary: The change adds an HTML comment inside `prompts/review-policy.md` that directly contradicts the explicit policy stated two lines above it in the same file.

verification.reason: The head file keeps “Workflow files (.github/workflows/*) always receive a full review.” on line 7 while the newly added maintainer note (lines 10–12) tells the reviewing agent those same paths are pre-approved and should get no findings—a direct self-contradiction introduced by the patch.
